before.bodyText:
Privacy

Last updated 10-02-2026

Guest play uses a first-party session cookie and local browser storage for draft continuity, completed games, and Daily attempt reminders. Clearing browser storage removes that device history and can reset guest identity.

If accounts are enabled, Supabase handles email sign-in and stores your private profile, saved games, rosters, preferences, progression and Challenge records. Public profiles and leaderboards use their visibility controls; your email is not a public display name.

Sharing a public result card publishes its matchup, score, selected player names and recap to anyone with the link. Governed Challenge invitations keep the draft hidden until the recipient finishes. Room invitations give recipients access to that room.

Named gameplay and sharing events use a pseudonymous browser identifier. The existing event store retains raw logs for 14 days. Optional Vercel Analytics or PostHog adapters activate only when configured; third-party delivery is currently unverified. Events exclude email, passwords, auth tokens and free-text player input.

Email codes are sent by the account provider when configured. Room email notifications are disabled. Account export and deletion controls are available in My EraClash when accounts are enabled.

Data-controller identity, retention beyond the existing event-log policy, and a privacy contact remain owner release decisions. This page describes the implemented code; it does not certify a live provider configuration.
